body: Commit 3a4c845 (+ CHANGELOG 35ab0fe): ARENA_HALF_EXTENT 28->32 ('the map should be a little bigger'), arena_graveyard_position() moved from dead-center-behind-spawn to the two map corners fountains don't already occupy ('graveyards behind 2 of the corners not in the middle'). Also fixed a real gap founder suspected ('i think there may be zombie games with infinite win cons'): S170-153's resource-race win condition had no timeout fallback -- removing team-wipe removed the only guarantee a live match eventually ends, and arena_server's LIVE-phase loop had no timeout of its own. Added ARENA_MATCH_MAX_DURATION_MS (12min) sudden-death: whoever's ahead on resources wins outright past that point, tiebroken by nodes owned. 4 new tests, full suite green, live-verified via isolated 20-bot match confirming wider map bounds in real movement.
title: S170-155/156/157: bigger map + corner graveyards + sudden-death zombie-match fix
